cohort: Eight existing Ohio-based companies: installation, maintenance, electrical, advisory, manufacturing and distribution.

expectedProfile.description: Yellowlite Inc operates in solar installation. Its published company location is Cleveland, OH. Listed services include solar installation.

profile.description: YellowLite designs and installs solar and battery systems for homes, businesses, farms, and institutions. Its services include project engineering, permitting and utility coordination, plus diagnostics, repairs, and ongoing monitoring for existing systems, including systems installed by others.
profile.tagline: Solar installation, engineering, battery storage, and system care.

research.identityNote: Official domain and Cleveland office match the existing listing. Neighboring-state installation can involve partners.

services.title: Solar design and installation
services.detail: Site assessment, system design, permitting, installation, and utility coordination for new solar projects.

services.title: Solar engineering and permitting
services.detail: Site layouts, production modeling, electrical and structural plans, civil design, and interconnection documentation.

services.title: Home battery installation
services.detail: Battery system sizing, permits, installation, and integration with home solar or backup power.

services.title: Solar repair and maintenance
services.detail: Fault diagnosis, equipment replacement, monitoring, and warranty coordination; accepts systems installed by other providers.

services.title: Home EV charger installation
services.detail: EV charging is offered among the upgrades for residential solar customers.

products.title: Solar panels and system equipment
products.detail: Equipment supplied as part of solar installation projects.

products.title: Home batteries
products.detail: Tesla Powerwall and FranklinWH home storage systems.

sources.title: Company and service area
sources.evidence: Lists Cleveland, Columbus, and Cincinnati offices; solar installation coverage in Ohio, Indiana, Michigan, and Pennsylvania, including partners.

sources.title: Commercial solar
sources.evidence: Describes commercial project planning, installation, permits and grid coordination, and business, farm, school and municipal applications.

sources.title: Design and engineering
sources.evidence: Dedicated design service covers electrical, structural and civil planning, energy modeling and utility documentation.

sources.title: Home energy storage
sources.evidence: Offers home battery design and installation and names Tesla and FranklinWH systems.

sources.title: Service and maintenance
sources.evidence: Details residential and commercial service, third-party installations, Ohio service teams, EV charger upgrades and commercial O&M packages.

confirmationNeeded: Named staff credential and state engineering license verification
reviewNotes: NABCEP personnel and Tesla installer claims need issuer checks before required-certification matching.
O&M size range on the service page is not a company-wide installation capacity.
Do not treat an installation partner network as labor-only crew availability.

products.title: Solar foundations
products.detail: Ground screws, helical foundations, C-piles, and ballast options.

sources.title: Products and installation programs
sources.evidence: Lists racking/foundation product families, engineering, site delivery, and turnkey/certified installer programs.

sources.title: Company and Ohio manufacturing
sources.evidence: Describes its developer/EPC customer base, commercial/utility focus, and Ridgeville Corners operations.
